notes: Smart Split now auto-notifies people you split with (if they use the app) instead of relying only on the manual payment link, and your UPI ID can be changed anytime from Profile > Payment Settings instead of being locked in after the first setup. Family Sharing has a back button to Finance. Uncategorized UPI spends now get a sensible default category (under Rs.500 -> Groceries, Rs.500+ -> Shopping) instead of piling up as Uncategorized. Subscriptions can now be deleted, not just cancelled. Bills only auto-tracks charges actually categorized as Bills & Utilities, instead of guessing from any repeated merchant.
